alt.en: A server processor with its lid removed, seen from above: a large, dark, mirror-like silicon die with a pale gray border sits in the middle of a teal circuit board, surrounded by strips of gray sealant and rows of tiny components.
alt.zh: 从上方俯视一枚揭开顶盖的服务器处理器：一块深色、像镜面一样反光的大硅芯片镶着浅灰色边框，位于青绿色基板中间，四周是灰色的密封胶条和成排的微小元件。

caption.en: An engineering sample of an Intel Xeon server processor from the earlier Skylake-SP generation, with its lid removed, photographed in July 2020. The photo does not show NEAR AI's hardware.
caption.zh: 一枚揭开顶盖的 Intel Xeon 服务器处理器工程样品，属于较早的 Skylake-SP 一代，摄于 2020 年 7 月。照片并非 NEAR AI 所用的硬件。
